It's time for Health, Happiness, and Healing with Hippocrates on Legends 100.3, brought to you by the Hippocrates Health Institute in West Palm Beach. Call for your tour today, 561-471-8876, or visit HippocratesHealthInstitute.org.

In this episode Anna Maria and Brian Clement interview Dr. Anita Baxes about her Swiss medical background and the development of PlaqueX (phosphatidylcholine) — a natural infusion used to reduce arterial plaque, improve circulation, and support heart, brain and liver health. They discuss patient success stories, the science behind membrane repair and longevity benefits, regulatory challenges in Europe, and how PlaqueX is now available through U.S. compounding pharmacies and in Dr. Baxes’ book.
